verses.text: For di third year of di reign of King Belshazzar, vision appear to me, even to me Daniel, after di one wey appear to me at di first.
I see for di vision. E happen, when I see, say I dey Susa di palace, wey dey di province of Elam. I see for di vision, and I dey by di river Ulai.
Den I lift up my eyes, and see, and look, ram wey get two horns stand before di river. Di two horns dey high, but one dey higher pass di other, and di higher one come up last.
I see di ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward, so that no animals fit stand before am, neither any dey wey fit deliver out of im hand. But e do according to im will, and become great.
As I dey consider, see, male goat come from di west over di surface of di whole earth, and e no touch di ground. Di goat get notable horn between im eyes.
E come to di ram wey get two horns, wey I see standing before di river, and run at am in di fury of im power.

I see am come close to di ram, and e dey moved with anger against am, and strike di ram, and break im two horns. Di ram get no power to stand before am. But e cast am down to di ground, and trample on am. None dey wey fit deliver di ram out of im hand.
Di male goat magnify imself exceedingly. When e dey strong, di great horn dey broken, and for im place come up four notable horns toward di four winds of heaven.
Out of one of dem come out little horn, wey grow exceedingly great, toward di south, and toward di east, and toward di glorious land.
E grow great, even to di army of heaven. Some of di army and some of di stars e cast down to di ground, and trample on dem.
Yes, e magnify imself even to di prince of di army. Di continual burnt offering dey taken away from am, and di place of im sanctuary dey cast down.
Di army dey given over to am with di continual burnt offering through disobedience. E cast down truth to di ground, and e do im will and prosper.

Den I hear one holy one speaking, and another holy one talk to dat certain one wey dey speak, “How long di vision concerning di continual burnt offering, and di disobedience wey cause desolation, to give both di sanctuary and di army to dey trampled under foot?”
E talk to me, “To 2,300 evenings and mornings. Den di sanctuary go dey cleansed.”
E happen, when I, even I Daniel, don see di vision, and sought di meaning, see, one wey get di appearance of man stand before me.
I hear man voice between di banks of Ulai, wey call, and talk, “Gabriel, make dis man understand di vision.”
So e come near where I stand. When e come, I dey afraid, and fall on my face. But e talk to me, “Understand, son of man, because di vision na for di time of di end.”
Now as e dey speak with me, I dey in deep sleep with my face to di ground. But e touch me, and set me upright.
E talk, “See, I go make you know wetin go happen for di last time of di indignation, because e na for di appointed time of di end.
Di ram wey you see wey get two horns na di kings of Media and Persia.
Di rough male goat na di king of Greece. Di great horn wey dey between im eyes na di first king.
As for dat wey dey broken, and four stand up for im place, four kingdoms go stand up out of di nation, but no with im power.
For di latter time of dem kingdom, when di transgressors don reach full, king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, go stand up.
Im power go dey mighty, but no by im own power. E go destroy wonderfully, and go prosper and do im will. E go destroy di mighty ones and di holy people.

Through im policy e go cause deceit to prosper for im hand. E go magnify imself for im heart, and e go destroy many unawares. E go also stand up against di prince of princes, but e go dey broken without hand.
Di vision of di evenings and mornings wey dem tell dey true. But seal up di vision, because e dey for many days to come.”
I, Daniel, faint, and dey sick certain days. Den I rise up, and do di king business. I dey astonished at di vision, but none understand am.
For di first year of Darius, Ahasuerus pikin, of di offspring of di Medes, wey dem make king over di realm of di Chaldeans,

for di first year of im reign, I, Daniel, understand from di books di number of di years wey di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah di prophet, say e go accomplish 70 years for di desolations of Jerusalem.
I set my face to di Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes.
I pray to di Lord my God, and make confession, and talk, “Ah, Lord, di great and dreadful God, wey keep covenant and loving kindness with dem wey love am and keep im commandments,
we don sin, and don commit iniquity, and don do wickedly, and don rebel, even by departing from your precepts and from your ordinances.
Neither we don listen to your servants di prophets, wey speak for your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all di people of di land.

Lord, righteousness belong to you, but to us confusion of face, as e dey today, to di men of Judah, and to di inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, wey dey near, and wey dey far off, through all di countries where you don drive dem, because of dem trespass wey dem don trespass against you.
Lord, to us belong confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we don sin against you.
To di Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, because we don rebel against am.
Neither we don obey di voice of di Lord our God, to waka for im laws, wey e set before us by im servants di prophets.

Yes, all Israel don transgress your law, even by departing, so that dem no obey your voice. Therefore di curse dey poured out on us, and di oath wey dey written for di law of Moses di servant of God, because we don sin against am.
E don confirm im words, wey e speak against us, and against our judges wey judge us, by bringing on us great evil, because under di whole heaven nothing don dey done as e don dey done for Jerusalem.
As e dey written for di law of Moses, all dis evil don come on us. Yet we no make our prayer before di Lord our God, so that we go turn from our iniquities, and have discernment for your truth.
Therefore di Lord don watch over di evil, and bring am on us, because di Lord our God dey righteous for all im works wey e do, and we no obey im voice.
Now, Lord our God, wey don bring your people out of di land of Egypt with mighty hand, and don make you renown, as e dey today, we don sin, we don do wickedly.

Lord, according to all your righteousness, I beg you, make your anger and your wrath dey turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain, because for our sins, and for di iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people don become reproach to all wey dey round about us.
Now therefore, our God, hear di prayer of your servant, and im supplications, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary wey dey desolate, for di Lord sake.

My God, incline your ear, and hear. Open your eyes, and see our desolations, and di city wey dem call by your name, because we no dey present our supplications before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies.
Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. No delay, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people dey called by your name.”
While I dey speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and di sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before di Lord my God for di holy mountain of my God,
yes, while I dey speaking for prayer, di man Gabriel, wey I don see for di vision at di beginning, wey dem cause to fly swiftly, touch me about di time of di evening offering.
E instruct me, and talk with me, and talk, “Daniel, I don come out now to give you wisdom and understanding.
At di beginning of your supplications di commandment go out, and I don come to tell you, because you dey greatly beloved. Therefore consider di matter, and understand di vision.

70 weeks dey decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, and to make an end of sins, and to make atonement for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint di most holy place.

Know therefore and understand, say from di going out of di commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem to di anointed one, di prince, go be seven weeks, and 62 weeks. E go dey built again, with street and moat, even for times of trouble.

After di 62 weeks di anointed one go dey cut off, and e go get nothing. Di people of di prince wey go come go destroy di city and di sanctuary. Im end go be with flood, and to di end e go be war. Desolations dey determined.

E go make firm covenant with many for one week. For di middle of di week e go cause sacrifice and offering to cease. On di wing of abominations go come one wey make desolate, even until di full end, wey dey determined, dey poured out on di desolator.”

For di third year of Cyrus king of Persia, one thing dey revealed to Daniel, wey dem call Belteshazzar. Di thing na true, and e concern great conflict. E understand di thing, and e get understanding of di vision.
For dose days I, Daniel, dey mourning three whole weeks.
I ate no pleasant bread, neither meat nor wine come into my mouth, neither I anoint myself at all, till di whole three weeks complete.
For di 24th day of di first month, as I dey by di bank of di great river, wey be Hiddekel,
I lift up my eyes, and look, and see, one man clothed in linen, wey im waist dey girded with fine gold of Uphaz.

Im body also dey like beryl, and im face like di appearance of lightning, and im eyes like flaming torches, and im arms and im feet like di colour of burnished bronze, and di voice of im words like di voice of multitude.
I, Daniel, alone see di vision, because di men wey dey with me no see di vision, but great quaking fall on dem, so that dem flee to hide demselves.
So I dey left alone, and see dis great vision, and no strength remain inside me, because my comeliness dey turned inside me into corruption, and I retain no strength.
Yet I hear di voice of im words. When I hear di voice of im words, den I dey in deep sleep on my face, with my face toward di ground.
See, hand touch me, wey set me on my knees and on di palms of my hands.
E talk to me, “Daniel, you wey dey greatly beloved, understand di words wey I speak to you, and stand upright, because I don dey sent to you now.” When e don speak dis word to me, I stand trembling.
Den e talk to me, “No fear, Daniel, because from di first day wey you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words dey heard. I don come because of your words.
But di prince of di kingdom of Persia withstand me 21 days. But see, Michael, one of di chief princes, come to help me, and I remain dere with di kings of Persia.
Now I don come to make you understand wetin go happen to your people for di latter days, because di vision still dey for many days.”
When e don speak such words to me, I set my face toward di ground, and dey mute.

See, one in di likeness of di sons of men touch my lips. Den I open my mouth, and speak, and talk to am wey stand before me, “My lord, because of di vision my sorrows dey turned on me, and I retain no strength.
How fit di servant of dis my lord talk with dis my lord? Because as for me, straightway no strength dey remain in me, neither any breath dey left in me.”
Den di one wey get di appearance of man touch me again, and strengthen me.
E talk, “O man greatly beloved, no fear. Peace dey to you. Dey strong, yes, dey strong.” When e don speak to me, I dey strengthened, and talk, “Make my lord speak, because you don strengthen me.”
Den e talk, “You know why I don come to you? Now I go return to fight with di prince of Persia. When I go out, see, di prince of Greece go come.
But I go tell you wetin dey written for di book of truth. None dey wey hold with me against dem, except Michael your prince.”
“As for me, for di first year of Darius di Mede, I stand up to confirm and to strengthen am.

Now I go show you di truth. See, three more kings go stand up for Persia. Di fourth go be far richer pass dem all. When e don become strong through im riches, e go stir up all against di realm of Greece.
Mighty king go stand up, wey go rule with great dominion, and do according to im will.

When e don stand up, im kingdom go dey broken, and go dey divided toward di four winds of heaven, but no to im posterity, nor according to im dominion wey e rule, because im kingdom go dey plucked up, and given to others beside dem.
Di king of di south go dey strong, and one of im princes, and e go dey strong above am, and rule. Im dominion go be great dominion.

For di end of years dem go join demselves together, and di daughter of di king of di south go come to di king of di north to make agreement. But she no go retain di strength of her arm, neither e go stand, nor im arm. But she go dey given up, and dem wey bring her, and im wey beget her, and im wey strengthen her for dose times.
But out of one branch of her roots one go stand up for im place, wey go come to di army, and go enter into di fortress of di king of di north, and go deal against dem, and go prevail.
E go also carry captive into Egypt dem gods, with dem molten images, and with dem precious vessels of silver and of gold. E go refrain some years from di king of di north.
Di king of di north go come into di realm of di king of di south, but e go return into im own land.
Im sons go wage war, and assemble multitude of great forces, wey go come on, and overflow, and pass through. Den e go return, and wage war, even to im fortress.
Di king of di south go dey moved with anger, and go come out and fight with am, even with di king of di north. E go raise great multitude, but di multitude go dey given into im hand.
When di multitude don dey taken away, im heart go dey lifted up. E go cast down many tens of thousands, but e no go dey strengthened by am.
Di king of di north go return, and go raise multitude greater pass di first, and e go come on at di end of years with great army and with much equipment.
For dose times many go stand up against di king of di south. Also di violent men among your people go lift up demselves to establish di vision, but dem go fall.
So di king of di north go come, and cast up mound, and take di fortified city. Di forces of di south no go stand, neither im chosen people, neither any strength go dey to stand.
But im wey come against am go do according to im own will, and none go stand before am. E go stand for di glorious land, and destruction go dey for im hand.
E go set im face to come with di strength of im whole kingdom, and with im upright ones. Thus e go do. E go give am di daughter of women to corrupt am, but she no go stand, neither go dey for am.
After dis e go turn im face to di islands, and go take many. But one commander go cause di reproach offered by am to cease. Yes, moreover e go cause im reproach to turn on am.
Den e go turn im face toward di fortresses of im own land, but e go stumble and fall, and no go dey found.
Den one go stand up for im place wey go send tax collector through di glory of di kingdom. But within few days e go dey destroyed, no in anger, nor in battle.
For im place one contemptible person go stand up, to whom dem no go give di honour of di kingdom. But e go come in peaceably, and obtain di kingdom by flatteries.
Di overflowing forces go dey overflown from before am, and go dey broken, yes, also di prince of di covenant.
After di alliance wey dem make with am e go work deceitfully, because e go come up, and go become strong with small people.

E go enter into di richest places of di province wey no dey suspect, and e go do wetin im fathers no do, nor im fathers fathers. E go scatter among dem plunder, and booty, and riches. Yes, e go devise im plans against di strongholds, but only for time.

E go stir up im power and im courage against di king of di south with great army. Di king of di south go wage war with exceedingly great and mighty army, but e no go stand, because dem go devise plans against am.
Yes, dem wey eat of im food go destroy am, and im army go dey swept away. Many go fall down slain.
As for di two kings, dem hearts go be to do mischief, and dem go speak lies at one table. But e no go prosper, because di end go still dey for di appointed time.
Den e go return into im land with great riches. Im heart go dey against di holy covenant. E go do exploits, and return to im own land.
For di appointed time e go return, and come into di south, but e no go be as di former or as di latter.

Because ships of Kittim go come against am. Therefore e go dey grieved, and go return, and have indignation against di holy covenant, and go do exploits. E go even return, and give heed to dem wey forsake di holy covenant.
Forces go stand on im part, and dem go profane di sanctuary, even di fortress, and go take away di continual burnt offering. Dem go set up di abomination wey make desolate.
Dem wey do wickedly against di covenant, e go corrupt dem by flatteries, but di people wey know dem God go dey strong, and do exploits.
Dem wey dey wise among di people go instruct many. Yet dem go fall by di sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.
Now when dem go fall, dem go dey helped with little help, but many go join demselves to dem with flatteries.
Some of dem wey dey wise go fall, to refine dem, and to purify, and to make dem white, even to di time of di end, because e still dey for di appointed time.

Di king go do according to im will. E go exalt imself, and magnify imself above every god, and go speak marvelous things against di God of gods. E go prosper until di indignation dey accomplished, because wetin dey determined go dey done.
Neither e go regard di gods of im fathers, nor di desire of women, nor regard any god, because e go magnify imself above all.
But for im place e go honour di god of fortresses. A god wey im fathers no know e go honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
E go deal with di strongest fortresses with di help of foreign god. Whoever acknowledge am, e go increase with glory. E go cause dem to rule over many, and e go divide di land for price.

For di time of di end di king of di south go push at am. Di king of di north go come against am like whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships. E go enter into di countries, and go overflow and pass through.
E go enter also into di glorious land, and many countries go dey overthrown. But dis ones go escape out of im hand: Edom, and Moab, and di chief of di children of Ammon.
E go stretch out im hand also on di countries. Di land of Egypt no go escape.
But e go have power over di treasures of gold and of silver, and over all di precious things of Egypt. Di Libyans and di Ethiopians go dey at im steps.
But news out of di east and out of di north go trouble am. Therefore e go go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.
E go plant di tents of im palace between di sea and di glorious holy mountain. Yet e go come to im end, and no one go help am.

“At dat time Michael, di great prince wey stand for di children of your people, go stand up. Time of trouble go dey, such as never don dey since nation dey even to dat same time. At dat time your people go dey delivered, everyone wey dey found written for di book.
Many of dem wey sleep for di dust of di earth go awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
Dem wey dey wise go shine as di brightness of di expanse, and dem wey turn many to righteousness as di stars forever and ever.
But you, Daniel, shut up di words, and seal di book, even to di time of di end. Many go run to and fro, and knowledge go increase.”
Den I, Daniel, look, and see, two other ones stand, one on dis side of di bank of di river, and di other on dat side of di bank of di river.
One talk to di man clothed in linen, wey dey above di waters of di river, “How long e go be to di end of dis wonders?”

I hear di man clothed in linen, wey dey above di waters of di river, when e hold up im right hand and im left hand to heaven, and swear by am wey live forever say e go be for time, times, and half. When dem don finish breaking in pieces di power of di holy people, all dis things go finish.
I hear, but I no understand. Den I talk, “My lord, wetin go be di end of dis things?”
E talk, “Go your way, Daniel, because di words dey shut up and sealed till di time of di end.
Many go dey purified, and make white, and refined. But di wicked go do wickedly. None of di wicked go understand, but di wise go understand.
From di time wey di continual burnt offering go dey taken away, and di abomination wey make desolate set up, go be 1,290 days.
Blessed na im wey wait, and come to di 1,335 days.
But go your way until di end. You go rest, and go stand for your inheritance for di end of di days.”
